extracted.name: Cranberry whiskey sour
extracted.description: Give the classic whiskey sour a festive spin using cranberry juice. Garnish with frozen cranberries, if you have them, for an extra-Christmassy touch
instruction_lines: Put all the ingredients in a cocktail shaker and shake hard until it feels cold. Strain into two short tumblers.
